title: Squared sums over fibers
statement:
Let $A$ and $B$ be finite sets, let $g:A\to B$, and let $w:A\to\mathbb{R}$. Then
\[\sum_{y\in B}\left(\sum_{x\in A:\,g(x)=y}w(x)\right)^2=\sum_{x\in A}\sum_{x'\in A}\begin{cases}w(x)w(x')&g(x)=g(x'),\\0&g(x)\ne g(x').\end{cases}\]
